title: two try_send patterns in same loop — contributor will copy wrong one
description: The coalescing loop in events_handler has two try_send call sites for live_tx. Line 393 (close-signal path) uses .is_err() and the old implicit pattern. Line 432 (event path) uses the new explicit match on TrySendError::Full vs TrySendError::Closed. A future contributor adding a third try_send site — or copying from line 393 to understand the pattern — will use the inconsistent form. The two patterns should be unified so there is one canonical form to copy.
